morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为不可按本族词缀拆分的专名处理，正文通常写 Hansen。IPA 仅示意按马来语拼写读出的形式，不代表姓名持有者的原语读音。没有可据此建立的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 汉森：人名或姓氏的音译；常见于丹麦、挪威等姓名传统，具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Hansen, a personal name or surname, especially a surname associated with Danish and Norwegian naming traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama orang atau nama keluarga; rujukan khususnya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词解释，不据此认定它是马来语普通词。词包未提供 DBP 释义，本项马来文定义为编辑说明；当前信息也不足以确认独立 DBP 词条或具体人物。以下为自然的专名搭配示例，不宣称具有已核实的高频搭配地位。

etymology.historical_story: Hansen belongs to a Scandinavian patronymic tradition: it originally identified someone as a son of Hans. Danish genealogical guidance illustrates this with a father named Hans and a son called Peder Hansen. Such identifying expressions later functioned as hereditary surnames. This name history does not identify any particular Hansen in the supplied packet. [Danish Genealogical Society](https://admin.slektogdata.no/sites/default/files/2021-03/Introduction%20to%20Genealogy%20in%20Denmark.pdf)
